ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'An-Nar Al-Kubra' (The Greater Fire) in Shia Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Greater Fire' (An-Nar Al-Kubra) is often distinguished from lesser punishments, representing the ultimate and most severe abode for those who persist in disbelief or commit major sins without repentance. This phrase underscores the finality of divine retribution, emphasizing that the punishment is not merely physical but reflects the spiritual magnitude of the transgression against God's sovereignty.
